caption: Wrinkles, decoded - minus the jargon. What they actually are and what genuinely helps. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae

slides.headline: They're not damage
slides.sub: Just movement, sun and time doing their thing.

slides.headline: Sunscreen does the heavy lifting
slides.sub: Daily SPF is the single biggest thing you can do for fine lines.

slides.headline: What has the most evidence
slides.sub: Retinoids and consistency, over time. Gradual changes, not overnight ones.

slides.headline: In-clinic options exist too
slides.sub: A professional can match them to your skin and your goals.
